description: This file defines a PHP trait named EncryptionHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides methods for managing cryptographic operations, including obtaining a Cryptographer instance and checking if encryption is enabled. The code leverages static properties and methods, and interacts with a KeyHandler class.

methods.name: getCryptographer
methods.description: Returns the Cryptographer instance if encryption is enabled, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the Cryptographer instance is set, indicating if encryption is enabled.
